Third-party runtimes, vendored unmodified (all free and open source):

| Folder / file | Package | Version | Licence | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| sql-wasm.js, sql-wasm.wasm | sql.js (SQLite) | 1.13.0 | MIT | MySQL and SQLite courses |
| pglite/ | @electric-sql/pglite (PostgreSQL + pgvector) | 0.3.14 | Apache-2.0 / PostgreSQL | PostgreSQL and vector courses |
| pyodide/ | Pyodide (CPython 3.14) with numpy 2.4.6, pandas 3.0.2, python-dateutil, pytz, six | 314.0.7 | MPL-2.0 (Pyodide); BSD-3 (numpy, pandas) | pandas course |

Sources: cdnjs (sql.js), https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@electric-sql/pglite@0.3.14/dist/,
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v314.0.7/full/
